lead.headline: Wildfire on Reno's edge forces tens of thousands to evacuate
lead.dek: The human-caused Hawk Fire burned 15,000 acres with no containment; the National Guard is mobilized
body: A wind-driven wildfire burning into the Sierra Nevada foothills on Reno's northwest edge forced about 42,000 people from their homes by Sunday evening, with 45,000 more told to be ready to leave. The Hawk Fire had burned more than 15,000 acres since Saturday and was 0% contained.

The fire was human-caused, said Shane Akerson, a Truckee Meadows fire battalion chief. At least six people were hurt, three of them first responders. Gov. Joe Lombardo declared an emergency in Washoe County and sent National Guard helicopter crews and 60 troops.

It is the third major fire to hit northern Nevada in a month, after the Bug and Stallion fires together burned more than 130,000 acres. Nationally, 7.7 million acres have burned this year, the most at this point in a decade.

briefs.headline: Tropical Storm Moke threatens Hawaii's flood recovery
briefs.summary: Up to 15 inches could fall on a Big Island still recovering from Lala's 30-plus; Gov. Josh Green requested a presidential emergency declaration.

briefs.headline: Ex-deputy convicted in Sonya Massey's killing dies in prison
briefs.summary: Grayson, 32, was serving 20 years for second-degree murder; his attorney confirmed the death. He had advanced cancer and was denied medical release in July.

briefs.headline: Treasury details Iran sanctions today after 'economic D-Day' vow
briefs.summary: Secondary sanctions on buyers of Iranian oil are expected; China takes about 90% of Iran's oil exports, and crude fell 2% Monday morning.

briefs.headline: Strike on suspected drug boat kills two in eastern Pacific
briefs.summary: Southern Command announced the strike Monday; rights groups say the campaign, which AFP counts at 200-plus dead, may be extrajudicial killing.

briefs.headline: Landslide at Conakry landfill kills 30 in Guinea
briefs.summary: Rain-soaked waste at the Dar Es Salam dump buried tents and homes early Sunday; the site had been due to close that same day.

briefs.headline: Syrian court sentences Assad-era grand mufti to life
briefs.summary: Ahmad Badreddin Hassoun, grand mufti from 2005 to 2021, was convicted in Damascus of inciting violence and abuse of office during the civil war.

briefs.headline: Allies convene in Kyiv as Zelenskyy asks for 300 interceptors
briefs.summary: Zelenskyy said interceptor deliveries fell from 675 in 2023 to a projected 264 this year; Norway pledged $9.1B for 2027.

briefs.headline: New ruling party takes Kazakhstan's 145-seat chamber
briefs.summary: Adilet took about 71% and a projected 105-plus of 145 seats in the first unicameral vote.

briefs.headline: McCuskey redirects future opioid settlement money to the state
briefs.summary: Future settlement proceeds go 72.5% to general revenue instead of the First Foundation, which has received about $330M since 2022 and expects no major impact.

briefs.headline: Bank seeks $52.3M judgment against Greenbrier Hotel Corp.
briefs.summary: First Guaranty asked a federal court Thursday for a judgment on a 2020 loan delinquent since 2023; the Lottery Commission votes on the resort's new board Wednesday.

regional.item: Council takes up the revised Flock ordinance tonight; opponents spent the weekend canvassing for a ballot ban.

away.item: Vandals spray-painted the Veterans Home honor rolls Saturday; volunteers had them clean within hours.

fishing.line: Sound highs 5:48 a.m. and 6:30 p.m.; lows 12:07 a.m. and 12:01 p.m.

briefs.headline: NASA sets Roman telescope launch for Sunday morning
briefs.summary: The dark-energy observatory, with a Hubble-size mirror and a 100-times-wider view, launches Aug. 30 on a Falcon Heavy, eight months early.

briefs.headline: Alzheimer's risk gene shrinks neurons years before symptoms
briefs.summary: Gladstone Institutes tied APOE4 to a protein that makes neurons shrink and misfire in mice, and reversed the damage. In Nature Aging.

briefs.headline: AI finds the 'on switch' in 60% of human genes
briefs.summary: UC San Diego trained a model on 500,000 sequences to read the initiator, the DNA mark where gene expression begins.

briefs.headline: Speaking more languages tracks with younger brains
briefs.summary: A Basque Center study of 872 people found four-language speakers' brains reading about 13 years younger, presented at Europe's neuroscience forum.
